a: A "by doing X" condition can't be met if only some of the required actions are performed.
You must return the specified number of cards from your trash to the deck for the condition of this card's [All Turns] effect.
Card Q&A.q: Can I return just 2 cards from my trash to the deck for the condition of this card's [All Turns] effect?

Effect: [All Turns] When this Digimon would leave the battle area by effects, by returning 3 cards with [Dex] or [DeathX] in their names from your trash to the bottom of the deck, it doesn't leave.
[End of All Turns] [Once Per Turn] Delete all Digimon with the lowest level.
